title: ECERC : Evidence-Cause Attention Network for Multi-Modal Emotion Recognition in Conversation
caption: Figure 3: Illustration of different masks. Hmask: Masked for historical context; Imask: masked for the speaker self; Smask: masked for the speaker in context; Cmask: masked for other parties in context. p1 and p2 represent two parties. The vertical axis represents Q and the horizontal axis represents K in Attention. Green and white represent the attention and inattention among parties, respectively.
